This '''clone navigation officer''' served aboard the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dao/Legends|Dao]] during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] in<ref name="Supply Lines" /> [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="ERC" /> Afer the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] fleet disabled the shields of the flagship, the clone warned Dao about this development. However, the naval officer, Dao and the rest of his crew were instantly killed when their defenseless Star Destroyer fell to enemy turbolaser fire.<ref name="Supply Lines" />
